assumptions.statement: Primary audience: Croatian-speaking people interested in fitness, health and sports apparel.
assumptions.basis: inferred from caption language, topic hashtags and product range; no audience analytics were available

limitations: Which packaging generation (old vs new) is shipped for each priced variant is NOT established: text data cannot tell, so every variant carries packaging_generation='unverified'. Gallery photos show both generations (see packaging_observations, operator-attested).
Product images are listed per product page, not per variant: the JSON-LD gives fewer images than variants, and file names such as 'km750g' only suggest a size. Image-to-variant mapping is unverified.
Prices, availability and ratings are snapshots as of each source's retrieved_at.
Packaging observations caveat: These are gallery photos. Which pouch generation is physically shipped for a given priced variant (size x flavour) is NOT established by this file.
Reference images were downloaded for 4 of 8 catalog products (research.max_images cap); the others have none stored.

Website colours/typography are measured from CSS. Instagram cover analysis (if present) is operator-labelled on cover frames only, from images that are not stored in the repository; no vision model ran in the studio.

Instagram: 30 brand-owned posts from 'Apify actor apify/instagram-post-scraper via the Apify MCP connector; dataDetailLevel=basicData' (origin: manual_import); 14 collaboration/tagged posts by other accounts were seen and excluded from brand-voice analysis. Likes/comments are a snapshot; hidden counts stay null.
